capabilities: : Add anchored comments to text snippets
: Display comments in a dedicated sidebar
: Store comments in separate linked notes
disambiguation: Not a general note-taking tool; it specifically anchors comments to precise text snippets within a document.
problem: Users need a way to attach specific feedback or notes directly to precise sections of text within a document without cluttering the main content.
summary: Plugin that allows users to add anchored comments to specific text snippets using colored highlights and a dedicated sidebar.
